Rashi on Gittin 29b:10:1.hebrew: והא שליח שלא ניתן לגירושין הוא - השליח הזה לא נעשה שליח לגרשה אלא למוסרו לאבא בר מניומי, הלכך לאו במקום בעל קאי למוסרו ליד אחר:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:10:1.english: But isn't he an agent who was not granted [authority] for divorce - This agent was not made an agent to divorce her, but rather to deliver it [the bill of divorce] to Abba bar Minyumi; therefore, he does not stand in the husband's place to deliver it into the hand of another:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:11:1.english: He struck them down - He cut off their legs, so that they would not find legs [i.e., support] for their words:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:11:2.hebrew: מאי קפחותא - הלא אינה תשובה, דמי אמר ליה בעל: "אבא בר מניומי יגרשנה ולא אתה"? אי הוה האי ידע לה, הרי צוהו תחלה לגרשה; לשון קיפוח — דטרונציי"ר, שמקצרו מלמטה:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:11:2.english: What is the cutting refutation [kippuch] - Why, it is not a [valid] refutation, for did the husband say to him, "Abba bar Minyumi shall divorce her, and not you"? If this [first agent] knew her, behold, he commanded him first to divorce her! The term kippuch [means] detronchier [Old French: to lop off / cut short], as one cuts it short from below:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:12:1.hebrew: איכא דאמרי - דרבא אמר שאינה תשובה, אלא בטעות קפחם; ואמר (ליה) רב אשי: מאי טעותא? שפיר קפחינהו:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:12:1.english: There are those who say - that Rava said that [Rav Safra's argument] was not a [valid] refutation, rather he defeated them mistakenly; and Rav Ashi said [to him]: "What [was] the mistake? He defeated them properly:"

Rashi on Gittin 29b:12:2.english: What did he say to him - [Meaning,] the husband:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:12:3.hebrew: אבא בר מניומי יגרשנה ולא אתה - מאחר שאינך מכירה, הוא יהא שליח מעתה, ולאו את. בלישנא קמא גרסינן: "מי אמר ליה"; בלישנא בתרא גרסי': "מאי קאמר ליה":
Rashi on Gittin 29b:12:3.english: Abba bar Minyumi shall divorce her, and not you - Since you do not recognize her, he shall be the agent from now on, and not you. In the first version, we read: "Did he say to him"; in the latter version, we read: "What did he say to him":

Rashi on Gittin 29b:13:1.english: He was prevented [by circumstances beyond his control] - [This refers to] the agent:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:13:2.english: Within thirty [days] - [meaning] that he would not be able to go after thirty [days]:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:14:1.english: He is an agent who is not granted [the ability] to [effect] divorce - within [the] thirty [days]:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:15:1.hebrew: וליחוש - שמא בא בעל אצלה בתוך שלשים יום, ונתייחד עמה, ופייסה ובעל, והוי גט ישן:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:15:1.english: And let there be a concern - lest the husband came to her within thirty [days], and was secluded with her, and appeased her and cohabited [with her], and it becomes an outdated bill of divorce:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:15:2.hebrew: ליחוש שמא פייס - בתוך י"ב חדש, שיש שהות הרבה לבא; ואין זה דומה לשולח גט ממדינת הים ואינו קובע זמן לשהותו בידו, דהתם ליכא למיחש שמא פייס, דמימר אמר הבעל: "השליח קדמני וכבר הגיע גט לידה", ולא עקר נפשיה מספיקא:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:15:2.english: Let there be a concern lest he appeased [her] - Within [the] twelve months, when there is ample time to come; and this is not similar to one who sends a bill of divorce from overseas and does not set a time for it to remain in his [the agent's] hand, for there, there is no [reason] to be concerned lest he appeased [her], because the husband says [to himself]: "The agent has preceded me and the bill of divorce has already reached her hand," and he does not uproot himself [to travel] out of doubt:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:16:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן - ואמר רבה כו', באומר בפני בית דין בשעה שמסרו לשליח: "הרי היא נאמנת עלי כמאה עדים לעולם, אם אערער לומר גט ישן הוא, הריני מאמינה לאמר שלא באתי בתוך הזמן אצלה". וכיון דמעיקרא הימנה, תו לא מהימן לערער, וכל שכן דאנן לא ליקו ולערער; אלמא טעמא דאמר הכי, אבל האי דלא אמר הכי, ליחוש:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:16:1.english: This is how we read [the text] - "And Rabbah [bar Rav Huna] said, etc., where he says" — [meaning, where he says] before a court at the time he handed [the bill of divorce] to the agent: "She is believed by me like a hundred witnesses forever; if I contest [it] by saying it is an outdated bill of divorce, I grant her credibility to say that I did not come to her within the [allotted] time." And since from the outset he granted her credibility, he is no longer believed to contest [it], and all the more so that we should not arise and contest [it]. Thus, the reason [there is no concern] is that he said this; but in this [case], where he did not say this, we should be concerned:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:17:1.english: If they said [this] with regard to a married woman - for she is dear to him and he seeks to appease her:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:1:1.hebrew: ואזל איהו ויהיב לה גיטא - ברישא, דכי אמר ליה "שקול חפץ ברישא", קפיד איהו, שהיה בדעתו לעכב הגט אם לא תתן לו החפץ ולרדותה בעיגונא עד שתתן. הלכך הגט תלה בחפץ בדבר זה, וזה אם שינה, נעשה כמי שאמר לו "אל תגרשנה אלא בבית" וגירשה בעלייה. הלכך ר' יוחנן פוסל בו, בשליח ראשון, וכ"ש בשלוחו, והיינו דקאמר: "זימנין דגיטא נמי לא הוי". הלכך תנא במתני': "לא ישלחנו ביד אחר", שמא כשימסור ראשון שליחות לשני לא ימסור לו דברים כהוייתן, או השני לא ידקדק בהן, ויהא משנה ומיפסיל גיטא. וריש לקיש מכשר כו' — קסבר לאו קפידא הוא, אלא אורחא דמילתא קאמר ליה:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:1:1.english: And he went and gave her the get - first, for when [the husband] said to him, "Take the item first," he was particular [about the order], since his intention was to withhold the get if she did not give him the item and to coerce her by leaving her chained [in marriage] until she gives [it]. Therefore, the get was made contingent on the item in this matter, and if this [agent] deviated, it becomes like one who said to him, "Do not divorce her except in the house," and he divorced her in the upper story. Therefore, Rabbi Yochanan invalidates it [even when delivered] by him — by the first agent — and all the more so by his agent, and this is what he meant when he said [earlier]: "Sometimes it is not even a [valid] get." Therefore, the Mishnah taught: "He may not send it by the hand of another," lest when the first [agent] hands over the agency to the second, he will not convey the instructions to him as they were [given], or the second will not be meticulous about them, and he will deviate [from them] and the get will be invalidated. And Reish Lakish deems it valid, etc. — he holds that it is not a strict condition; rather, he was merely speaking to him in the normal manner of things:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:2:1.hebrew: עושה בב"ד שליח ומשלחו - שצריך הראשון לומר בפניהם "בפני נכתב ובפני נחתם", לפי שהאחרון לא יוכל לומר:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:2:1.english: He appoints an agent in court and sends him - For the first [agent] must say before them, "It was written in my presence and it was signed in my presence," because the final [agent] will not be able to say [this]:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:2:2.hebrew: שליח ב"ד אני - ומסתמא ב"ד עשו הדבר בהכשירו:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:2:2.english: I am an agent of the court - And presumably the court handled the matter properly:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:3:1.hebrew: שליח דשליח - השליח השני שנעשה בב"ד:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:3:1.english: An agent of an agent - The second agent, who was appointed in court:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:3:2.english: The final [agent] - And [the Mishnah] did not teach "the second":

Rashi on Gittin 29b:4:1.hebrew: ה"ג - "אלא כי תבעי לכו בב"ד, או אפי' שלא בב"ד":
Rashi on Gittin 29b:4:1.english: This is the [correct] reading - "Rather, when you raise the dilemma, [is it] in court, or even while not in court?":

Rashi on Gittin 29b:7:1.hebrew: עושה כמה שלוחין - ראשון לשני, ושני לשלישי, וכן לעולם, ואין צריך ב"ד; הואיל ואין הראשון צריך לומר "בפני נכתב", האחרון נמי א"צ לומר "שליח ב"ד אני":
Rashi on Gittin 29b:7:1.english: Appoints several agents - the first [appoints] a second, and the second [appoints] a third, and so on indefinitely, and a court is not needed; since the first [agent] does not need to say, "It was written in my presence," the last [agent] also does not need to say, "I am an agent of the court":

Rashi on Gittin 29b:7:2.english: If [the] first [agent] died - before the bill of divorce reached her hand:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:7:3.english: They are all canceled - [Rav Ashi] holds [that] they come from his authority:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:8:1.english: It is [from] his youth - In his youth, my father stated this teaching, which is open to refutation:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:9:1.english: I do not know her - I do not recognize her:

Rashi on Gittin 29b:9:2.hebrew: מסור מילך קמן - אמור דברי שליחותך בפנינו, ותן לנו הגט, ואמור "בפני נכתב ובפני נחתם", ואנו נמסרנו לו, ויהיה שליח ב"ד:
Rashi on Gittin 29b:9:2.english: Transfer your words before us - State the words of your agency before us, and give us the bill of divorce, and say, "In my presence it was written and in my presence it was signed," and we will hand it over to him, and he will be an agent of the court:

Tosafot on Gittin 29b:12:1.hebrew: הכי גר' ר"ת: א"ר אשי: מאי טעותא? מי קאמר ליה "אבא בר מניומי ולא את"? - וקאתי רב אשי לפרש מאי טעותא, ולב' הלשונות דברי רב אשי מכוונים, ולא קאי א"ד אלא אמילתא דרבא:
Tosafot on Gittin 29b:12:1.english: Rabbeinu Tam reads the text thus: Rav Ashi said: What is the mistake? Did he say to him, "Abba bar Minyumi and not you"? - And Rav Ashi comes to explain what the mistake was; and according to both versions, [the statements of] Rav Ashi are aligned, and [the phrase] "there are those who say" refers only to Rava's statement:

Tosafot on Gittin 29b:1:1.hebrew: שקול מינה חפץ והדר הב לה גיטא - משמע דוקא שהקפיד על לקיחת החפץ תחלה פליגי, אבל "הב לה גיטא ושקול מינה חפץ" לא. ותימה, דבפרק הכותב (כתובות דף פה.) אמרי' דלא שנא א"ל "שקול שטרא והב ליה זוזי", ולא שנא אמר ליה "הב ליה זוזי ושקול שטרא", משלם, דאמר ליה "לתקוני שדרתיך ולא לעוותי", כיון שהזכיר לקיחת השטר אע"פ שהזכיר לבסוף. ויש לומר דשאני התם, שפרעון המעות תלוין בשטר, ובהזכרת לקיחת השטר גלי דעתיה שירא שלא יאמרו "סיטראי נינהו":
Tosafot on Gittin 29b:1:1.english: Take an item from her and then give her the bill of divorce - This implies that they disagree specifically [where] he was particular about taking the item first, but [if he said,] "Give her the bill of divorce and take an item from her," [they do] not [disagree]. And this is astonishing, for in the chapter [entitled] Hakotev (Ketubot 85a), we say that whether he said to him, "Take the document and give him the zuzim," or whether he said to him, "Give him the zuzim and take the document," [if the agent gave the money without taking the document,] he must pay, because he says to him, "I sent you to benefit [me], and not to cause [me] harm," since he mentioned taking the document, even though he mentioned [it] at the end. And one can answer that there it is different, because the repayment of the money depends on the document, and by mentioning the taking of the document he revealed his mind that he is afraid lest they say, "They are [payment for] another [debt]":

Tosafot on Gittin 29b:1:2.hebrew: רבי יוחנן פוסל בו וכ"ש בשלוחו - פי' בקונט', דקפידת הבעל אינו אלא שלא ישאר החפץ ביד האשה, אבל במה שאמר ליה שיטול הימנה חפץ והוא משלח ביד אחר — אין הגט נפסל; ו"לא ישלחנו ביד אחר" דקתני במתניתין, היינו טעמא שמא לא ימסור לשני דברים כהוייתן, או השני לא ידקדק בהן ויפסול הגט. ולפי זה, הא דקתני "שאין רצונו שיהא פקדונו ביד אחר" — היינו ביד אשתו. וזה נראה דוחק, וגם זה דוחק ד"לא ישלחנו ביד אחר" שלא ישכח לומר כאשר אמר הבעל. ונראה לריב"א, דכשאמר "שקול מינה חפץ והדר הב לה גיטא", שתולה שליחות הגט בחפץ, פוסל ר' יוחנן נמי כשמשלח ביד אחר, אפי' לא שינה שליח השני מדעת הבעל ונטל ממנה החפץ קודם נתינת הגט; דכיון שתולה שליחות הגט בחפץ, כל מה שמשנה מדעת הבעל בחפץ — נפסל הגט. והכי פי': "רבי יוחנן פוסל בו" — בשליח ראשון כששינה, "וכ"ש בשלוחו" — ואפי' בלא שינוי; ולא ישלחנו ביד אחר — אפי' לא ישנה, דקפיד הבעל שאין רצונו שיהא פקדונו ביד אחר, פי': ביד השליח השני. ור"ל כו' כדפי' בקונט':
Tosafot on Gittin 29b:1:2.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan invalidates [it when delivered] by him, and all the more so by his agent - Rashi explained that the husband's insistence is only that the item should not remain in the woman's possession; however, in [respect to] what he told him, that he should take an item from her, and he sends [it] through another [person] — the bill of divorce is not invalidated. And [as for] "he may not send it through another," which [the Mishnah] teaches in the Mishnah, the reason is lest he not convey the matters to the second [agent] as they are, or lest the second [agent] not be meticulous about them and invalidate the bill of divorce. And according to this, that which [the Mishnah] teaches, "for it is not his wish that his deposit be in the hand of another" — that means in the hand of his wife. But this seems forced; and this too is forced, that "he may not send it through another" [is merely] lest he forget to say [it] just as the husband said. Rather, it appears to the Riva [Rabbi Yitzḥak ben Asher] that when [the husband] said, "Take an item from her and then give her the bill of divorce," such that he makes the agency of the bill of divorce dependent upon the item, Rabbi Yoḥanan invalidates [the bill of divorce] also when he sends [it] through another [person], even if the second agent did not deviate from the husband's intent and took the item from her before giving the bill of divorce — for since he makes the agency of the bill of divorce dependent upon the item, whenever [the first agent] deviates from the husband's intent regarding the item, the bill of divorce is invalidated. And this is [the Gemara's] meaning: "Rabbi Yoḥanan invalidates [it when delivered] by him" — by the first agent when he deviated — "and all the more so by his agent" — even without a deviation; and "he may not send it through another" — even if he will not deviate, for the husband insists that it is not his wish that his deposit be in the hand of another, meaning: in the hand of the second agent. And Reish Lakish [deems it valid], etc., as Rashi explained:
